Candidate-seeded block registration has 33/34 controls inliers, median 2.11 render pixels. A separately edge-seeded fit has 13/17 inliers, median 2.61 pixels, mostly left labels and three right outputs; neighboring-text and font matches and scanwarp limit both fits. Broad geometry is similar, bottom blocks have local differences, and no global shift was adopted. Before and after are the same block composite because V3 is unchanged; independent edge composite and regional comparisons are retained. Parent viewed 16 indexed route-section sheets for all 69 route records, 483 local windows at <=10 horizontal cells or <=2 vertical rows, with nominal adjacent-window overlap. Short and long paths were visually attempted in local sections, but nearby ink, block text, local registration and scan gaps prevent end-to-end electrical certification. Four point sheets cover all 19 junctions and 80 unjoined records; all point interpretations remain local visual assessments, not independently established net membership or proof of omitted wires. Route 19 is a short decoded stub, route 60 the AV passive branch; routes 45 and 46 have repeated backtracking data segments. Native child viewed all 20 tiles as regional screens, not every original wire or proof of no omissions. The geometric inventory reports no diagonal/zero-length segments and consistent represented crossings; it is not electrical evidence. AV native detail shows D07 at an upper branch and K D06 with a short lower line/upward stub near that branch. This does not establish another active output or connectivity. The unchanged source retains AV.o4 D06 point [153,76], K border [149,76], side null and auxiliary modifier; LOAD result remains driver AV.o3, targets AW.i5/AX.i5, passive AV.o4.
